spans.s:
खर खर, अस्, आ, अम्, hard, harsh, rough;
sharp, pungent, acid (opposed to मृदु and श्ल-
क्ष्ण); solid (opposed to द्रव, fluid); dense (as
clouds); sharp, hot (as wind); hurtful, injurious;
cutting (as a speech or word); sharp-edged; cruel;
(अस्), m. a donkey, an ass, a mule; N. of several
birds; an osprey, a heron, a crow; a thorny plant,
a sort of prickly nightshade; a quadrangular mound
of earth for receiving the sacrificial vessels; a Daitya
or demon in general; epithet of the Asura Dhenuka;
N. of a Rakṣas slain by Rāma, a younger brother
of Rāvaṇa: N. of an attendant of the Sun (= Dhar-
ma); N. of an attendant of Śiva; N. of a Rudra;
(आ), f. a kind of grass, Andropogon Serratus; (ई), f.
a she-ass.
—खर-काष्ठिका, f. the plant Sida
Cordifolia (बला).
—खर-कुटी, f. a stable for
asses, a donkey-stall (used as an abusive epithet); a
barber's shop.
—खर-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a
Rakṣas.
—खर-कोण or खर-क्वाण, अस्, m.
the francoline partridge.
—खर-कोमल, अस्, m.
the month Jyeṣṭha (‘bracing yet mild’).
—खर-
गन्ध-निभा or खर-गन्धा, f. the plant
Hedysarum Lagopodioides, = नाग-बला.
—खर-
गृह or खर-गेह, अम्, n. or खर-ग्रह, अस्,
m. a stable for asses.
—खर-घातन, अस्, m. the
tree Mesua Ferrea, commonly Nageśar.
—खर-
च्छद, अस्, m., N. of several plants, a kind of
reed or grass, Saccharum Cylindricum; another kind,
commonly Okera; [cf. उलूक, इत्कट, कुन्दर.]
—खर-ज्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. sharp or quick in
motion.
—खर-णस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or खर-णस,
अस्, आ, अम्, sharp-nosed; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
—खर-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more sharp, very sharp.
—खर-त्वच्, क्, f., N. of a plant, = अलम्बुषा.
—खर-दण्ड, अम्, n. a lotus, Nymphæa Lotus.
—खर-दला, f. opposite-leaved fig tree, Ficus
Oppositifolia; [cf. उदुम्बर.]
—खर-दूषण,
अस्, m. the thorn-apple, Datura Metel.
—खर-
धार, अस्, आ, अम्, having a harsh edge or one full
of notches like that of a saw.
—खर-ध्वंसिन्, ई,
m. destroyer of the demon Khara, an epithet of
Rāma.
—खर-नखर, अस्, m., N. of a lion.
—खर-नराय, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śatānanda.
—खर-नाद, अस्, m. the braying of an ass.
—खर-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, braying like an ass; (ई),
m., N. of a man; also of a Ṛṣi; (इनी), f. a kind
of perfume, = रेणुका (‘causing a donkey to bray?’).
—खर-नाल, अम्, n. a lotus.
—खर-प, अस्,
m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of
this man.
—खर-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of several
plants, a kind of Ocimum (तुलसी) and Tectona
Grandis; a kind of cane; also = हरिद्गर्भ and
मरुवक (a kind of Ocimum); (ई), f., N. of two
plants, Elephantopus Scaber (गोजिह्वा) and Ficus
Oppositifolia (काकोदुम्बरिका).
—खर-पत्त्र-
क, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = तिलक — खर-पात्र,
अम्, n. an iron pot or vessel.
—खर-पादाढ्य
(˚द-आढ्˚), अस्, m. the elephant or wood-apple,
Feronia Elephantum; [cf. कपित्थ.]
—खर-
पाल, अस्, m. a wooden vessel; [cf. खर-पात्र.]
—खर-पुष्प, अस्, m. a plant, commonly
Marüa, a kind of Ocimum, see मरुवक; (आ or
इका), f. a kind of Tulasi, Ocimum Gratissimum;
also Varvara.
—खर-प्रिय, अस्, m. a pigeon.
—खर-मज्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose
strength is very intense.
—खर-मञ्जरि, इस् or ई,
f. the plant Achyranthes Aspera; [cf. अपामार्ग.]
—खर-यान, अम्, n. a donkey-cart, any vehicle
drawn by asses.
—खर-रश्मि, इस्, m. the sun.
[]
—खर-रोमन् or खर-लोमन्, आ, m., N. of one
of the chiefs of the Nāga or serpent-race inhabiting
hell.
—खर-वल्लिका, f., N. of a plant, commonly
Gorakṣa Chākuliya, Hedysarum Lagopodioides;
[cf. नाग-बला.]
—खर-शब्द, अस्, m. an osprey;
the braying of an ass.
—खर-शाक, अस्, m. the plant
Clerodendrum Siphonanthus, = भार्गी.
—खर-
शाल, अस्, आ, अम्, born or produced in a donkey-stall;
(आ), f. a donkey-stable or stall.
—खर-सोनि, इस्, m.
or खर-सोन्द, अस्, m. or खर-सोल्ल, अस्, m. an
iron vessel.
—खर-स्कन्ध, अस्, m., N. of a tree,
= प्रियाल; (आ), f. Phœnix Sylvestris, = खर्जूरी.
—खर-स्वरा, f. wild jasmine, = वन-मल्-
लिका.
—खरांशु (˚र-अं˚), उस्, m. the sun.
—खरा-गरी, f. a kind of grass, Andropogon
Serratus.
—खराण्डक (˚र-अण्˚), अस्, m., N. of
one of Śiva's attendants.
—खराब्दाङ्कुरक
(˚र-अब्द-अङ्˚), अम्, n. lapis lazuli.
—खराश्वा
(˚र-अश्˚ ?), f. the plant Colosia Cristata, commonly
वनयमानी, = अज-गन्धा, अज-मोदा, करवी.
—खराह्वा (˚र-आह्˚), f., N. of a plant, = अज-
मोदा.
—खरिन्-धम or खरिन्-धय, अस्, आ,
अम् (खरिन् = खरिम् for खरीम्), drinking ass's
milk.
—खरी-जङ्घ, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्),
m. pl. the descendants of this man.
—खरी-वृष,
अस्, m. a jackass.

खार खार, अस्, or खारि, इस्, ई, m. f. a
Khāri, a measure of grain = 16 Droṇas or about
3 bushels; it is also reckoned at 1(1/2) Sūrpa or
3 Droṇas; also at 46 Gauṇīs or 4096 Palas, or at
4 Droṇas; (ई), f. a scar.
—खारिम्-पच, अस्, आ, अम्,
cooking a Khāri by measure; (a vessel &c.) in
which a Khāri may be cooked.
—खारी-वाप, अस्,
आ, अम्, sown with a Khārī of grain (as a field &c.).
खरिका, f. powdered musk.

खारिक or खारीक, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to or sown
with a Khāri of grain (as a field &c.).

खरटखरटाकृ खरट-खरटा-कृ, cl. 8. P.
-करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make the sound खरट.

खरालिक खरालिक, अस्, m. a barber (ग्रा-
मणी); a razor-case; an iron arrow (in this sense
also खरालक); a pillow.

खरु खरु, उस्, उस् or ऊस्, उ (said to be fr.
rt. खन्), white; foolish, idiotic, a fool; harsh,
cruel; desirous of improper or prohibited things;
(उस्), m. a tooth; a horse; pride; love or Kāma,
the deity of love; an epithet of Śiva; (उस्), f. a girl
who chooses her own husband.

खरोस्ति खरोस्ति, इस्, m. f. (?), N. of a place;
(a various reading has खरोष्टी.)

खर्खोद खर्खोद, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a kind of magic.
—खर्खोद-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
skilled in the Kharkhoda art, a conjurer (?).

खर्ज् खर्ज्, cl. 1. P. खर्जति, चखर्ज,
खर्जितुम्, to creak (like a carriage-
wheel); to worship, to treat with respect or courtesy;
to pain, make uneasy; to cleanse, make clean; [cf.
Hib. cairtim or cartaim, ‘to cleanse.’]
खर्गला, f., Ved. an owl or any similar night-bird.

खर्जिका, f. a relish, anything to provoke drink-
ing; [cf. खर्जु and खर्जूर.]

खर्जु, उस् or ऊस्, f. scratching, itching, itch,
scab, cutaneous eruption; a worm, a kind of insect;
the wild datura tree.
—खर्जू-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of
several plants, the thorn-apple; Calotropis Gigantea,
Cassia Alata or Tora, = चक्र-मर्द.
खर्जु; for ‘datura’ read date.

खर्जुर, अम्, n. silver; [cf. खर्जूर.]
—खर्-
जुर-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man.

खर्जूर, अस्, m. the tree Phœnix Sylvestris, the
date tree; a scorpion; N. of a man; (ई), f. the tree
Phœnix Sylvestris; the wild date tree; (अम्), n. the
fruit of the tree Phœnix Sylvestris; silver; yellow
orpiment; (also खल.)
—खर्जूर-रस, अस्, m.
the juice or extract of the wild date or Tāḍi, used
to leaven bread, and as an intoxicating liquor.

खार्जूर खार्जूर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. खर्जूर),
coming from or made of the tree Phœnix Sylvestris.
खर्जूरक, अस्, m. a scorpion.

खर्द् खर्द्, cl. 1. P. खर्दति, &c., to bite,
to sting, to sting venomously.

खर्पर खर्पर, अस्, m. a thief; a rogue, a
cheat; the skull; the half of a skull; a beggar's bowl
or dish; an umbrella or parasol; (ई, अम्), f. n. a kind
of collyrium or application to the eyes. See कर्पर.

खर्परिका, f. or खर्परीतुत्थ, अम्, n. or
खर्परीरसक, अम्, n. a kind of collyrium.

खर्पराल खर्पराल, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
See कन्दराल.

खर्ब् खर्ब्, cl. 1. P. खर्बति, &c., to go,
move; to go towards; [cf. Old Germ.
hwarb, hwarp, hwirbu, &c.; Goth. bi-hvairba,
‘to go round.’]

खर्म खर्म, अम्, n. virility, manliness;
wove silk.

खर्व् खर्व्, cl. 1. P. खर्वति, &c., to be
proud or haughty; [cf. गर्व्.]

खर्व खर्व or खर्ब, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
खर्ब् ?), mutilated, maimed, crippled, injured, im-
perfect; pressed down, low, dwarfish, short, little in
size or stature; (अस्), m., N. of one of the nine
Nidhis or treasures of Kuvera; the plant Trapa
Bispinosa [cf. कुब्जक]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a large
number, either 10,000,000,000, or 37 cyphers pre-
ceded by 1.
—खर्व-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being or
abiding in any mutilated object.
—खर्व-शाख,
अस्, आ, अम्, dwarfish, small, short.

खार्वा खार्वा, f. (fr. खर्व), the Tretā
or second Yuga of the world.

खर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. mutilated, im-
perfect, not full (as the moon).

खर्वट खर्वट, अस्, अम्, m. n. the capital
of a district of four hundred villages, a market or
country town; a village at the foot of a mountain;
(a various reading for कर्वट.)
खर्वुरा खर्वुरा, f., N. of a plant, = तरदी.

खर्वूज खर्वूज, अम्, n. the water-melon
(fr. the Pers. خربوزه kharbūza).

खार्कार खार्-कार, अस्, m. (खार् an ono-
matopoetic word and कार fr. 1. कृ), the braying
of an ass; [cf. खर.]

खार्गलि खार्गलि, इस्, m. (fr. खर्गला or
खृगल), an epithet of Kapi; (a various reading
has खार्जलि.)
